description: Issues involving delayed shipments, missed delivery dates, unreliable delivery estimates, or inaccurate tracking information.
Packages that are missing, lost, misdelivered, or incorrectly marked as delivered.
Customers reporting damaged, broken, defective, counterfeit, poor-quality, or incorrect products.
Requests or problems involving returns, return pickups, refunds, replacements, or delayed refund processing.
Payment failures, billing errors, unexpected charges, overcharging, unauthorized charges, or invoice issues.
Questions or disputes involving prices, discounts, promotional codes, promotional credits, or cashback.
Login, account access, verification, lockout, suspicious activity, fraud, phishing, or account-security problems.
Problems with the website, mobile app, Fire TV, Prime Video, digital content, or other technical functionality.
Order cancellations, subscription management, pre-order fulfillment, out-of-stock issues, and related order-management problems.
Unresponsive or ineffective customer support, unresolved escalations, communication problems, and general support questions.
